value.rationale: The result gives a fully parameterized, exact homotopy classification and rational bivariate Betti generating series for a natural periodic-boundary version of a previously studied king-graph family. The sharp Smith equality for an antipodal action is a non-obvious infinite-family symmetry consequence, and the full and fixed spaces differ degree-wise already at length three; thus this is not simply a rewording of the rectangular recurrence.
